description: One filter as a chip: the current selection reads on the trigger and the options are typed by their value. Copy: the label is the field being filtered; `allLabel` is the unfiltered state in the reader's words — "Any region", not "All".

props.name: multiple
props.description: Default true — several choices at once, and each toggle keeps the menu open. The word is `multiple`, matching <Combobox> and <SelectableTile>: this control called it `multiple` and nothing caught it, because lint:vocab reads union props and a boolean has no union (2026-08-26).

props.name: allLabel
props.description: Label of the permanent "all" row (e.g. "All types"). Empty value = all.

props.name: allCount
props.description: Optional trailing count on the "all" row (total across options).

props.name: allIcon
props.description: Optional leading icon on the "all" row (pair it with option icons).

props.name: showValue
props.description: Render the trigger as "Label: selected values" instead of the static label + count chip; values fall back to `allLabel` when nothing is selected.

props.name: valueText
props.description: Overrides the trigger value text (showValue mode) when something is selected, e.g. "2 operators" or a picked date range.

props.name: menuExtra
props.description: Extra rows/controls rendered after the "all" row (e.g. an option that reveals a date range). Rendered as-is: rows that must keep the menu open and free-form inputs bring their own propagation guards.

props.name: searchable
props.description: A search row pinned at the top of the menu that narrows the option rows as you type — for a vocabulary too long to scan (a 21-value role list is why it exists). The "all" row stays put, and closing the menu clears the query.

props.name: showTags
props.description: The current selection as removable tags directly under THIS trigger — read what is picked and undo a piece of it without reopening the menu. Under its own row, not pooled at the bottom of the panel: a tag beside the control that made it needs no second label saying where it came from.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder (and accessible name) of the search row. Default "Search".
